stage0270_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$ミスリル$$ West Pacific Fleet, Executive Office ～

stage0270_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...The gods of Mycenae...
　They are a terrifying enemy.」

stage0270_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$大塚$$
「Indeed...
　Our sole consolation is that they seem hostile to
　$$バアル$$ and Geminis.」

stage0270_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Even so, I doubt beings like that would act
　for humanity's sake.
　Counting on them to break the Prison of Time is risky.」

stage0270_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$大塚$$
「Exactly.
　We must defeat Geminis through our own strength
　and stop the $$エタニティ・フラット$$.」

stage0270_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...It seems the search for the Singularity is stalled.」

stage0270_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$大塚$$
「We have been searching between battles,
　but found neither a likely object nor a person.」

stage0270_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$大塚$$
「$$グーラ$$ and $$あしゅら男爵$$ were possible candidates,
　but we could find no conclusive proof.」

stage0270_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Certainly, both of them had no small influence
　on the course the world took.」

stage0270_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But $$あしゅら男爵$$ took his own life, while Prince $$グーラ$$
　slept when the $$新世時空震動$$ occurred.
　Neither is likely to be the Singularity.」

stage0270_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$大塚$$
「For now, repairing $c's damaged machines
　must take priority.」

stage0270_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$大塚$$
「The Super Robots and $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ machines will be repaired
　at the Far East Branch and NERV.」

stage0270_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Understood.
　Then we will handle the Mobile Suits and other units
　at $$メリダ島$$.」

stage0270_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$大塚$$
「Federation High Command is apparently planning
　a major operation against Neo Zeon.」

stage0270_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The world is about to change dramatically.」

stage0270_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$大塚$$
「Chrono is behind the Earth supremacists.
　And Chrono is connected to Geminis.」

stage0270_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$大塚$$
「Geminis wants humanity extinct, so why would Chrono
　help them...?」

stage0270_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Judging by Chrono's movements, perhaps Geminis
　has made Spacenoids its first target.」

stage0270_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$大塚$$
「So the Earth supremacists mean to exploit Geminis
　to enforce their petty prejudice and ego...?」

stage0270_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Changing that is also part of our fight.」

stage0270_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$大塚$$
「Indeed...
　While pursuing Geminis, we must also seriously
　consider the prospect of fighting Chrono...」

stage0270_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's in perfect shape!
　GAI Mode can now operate for up to ten minutes!」

stage0270_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I'm sorry.
　It was a dimensional joke.」

stage0270_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah...!
　Just don't punish me with $$ブーストアップ$$!
　I beg you!」

stage0270_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Speaking of which, $n...
　Have you decided where you're going?」

stage0270_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$c is splitting into two groups
　while its machines are repaired.」

stage0270_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But $$ＡＧ$$ will repair our $$ジェニオン$$,
　so we aren't required to join
　either team.」

stage0270_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's why you get to decide for yourself
　where to go, $n.」

stage0270_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ooh...!
　Just like a licensed one-man army!」

stage0270_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（To think a little flattery would please him...
　Honest, or maybe just easy to manipulate...
　He still has a long way to go.）

stage0270_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The $$メリダ島$$ team will use
　the $$ラー・カイラム$$, $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, and Ptolemaios
　as its motherships...」

stage0270_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It includes Mobile Suits, AS, KMF, and AT units.」

stage0270_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So the other team is mainly Super Robots?」

stage0270_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes.
　That team will remain here at the Far East Branch.」

stage0270_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Its motherships are the Macross Quarter, $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$,
　and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$...」

stage0270_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It will have $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, the Mazinger Team,
　$$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$, Takeo General Company,
　$$２１世紀警備保障$$, Crusher Team, Getter Team...」

stage0270_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The Dai-Gurren Brigade, Team D, EVA, Big O,
　Aquarion, $$オーガス$$, Fire Bomber,
　and $$ガンバスター$$ will also be assigned to it.」

stage0270_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$メリダ島$$ or Japan...
　Which will you choose, $n?」

stage0270_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$n
「An enemy attack en route would be dangerous.
　I'll accompany the team going to $$メリダ島$$.」

stage0270_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You're the leader of our team, $n.
　I have no objections.」

stage0270_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes, Team $$ＤＥＭ$$...
　Its members are $n, me, and $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0270_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not bad.
　I'll prepare matching T-shirts for us.」

stage0270_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What is it?
　Would you rather have matching gang coats?」

stage0270_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$n
「The Super Robots took heavy damage fighting Mycenae.
　I'll stay in Japan
　to help fill the gap they left.」

stage0270_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You're the leader of our team, $n.
　I have no objections.」

stage0270_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes, Team $$ＤＥＭ$$...
　Its members are $n, me, and $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0270_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not bad.
　I'll prepare matching T-shirts for us.」

stage0270_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What is it?
　Would you rather have matching gang coats?」

stage0270_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$サイガス$$
「...That concludes Federation High Command's decision.」

stage0270_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$大統領$$
「You made a decision without awaiting my approval,
　Brigadier General $$サイガス・エイロニー$$?」

stage0270_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$サイガス$$
「My apologies.
　Then please sign your approval
　for the operation proposed by High Command.」

stage0270_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$大統領$$
「An attack on a colony meant to intimidate...
　Do you truly expect me to approve such a thing?」

stage0270_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Indeed, it would violate the wartime treaty
　you and $$シャア・アズナブル$$ agreed upon,
　which forbids involving noncombatants.」

stage0270_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$大統領$$
「Then why, when you know that...!?」

stage0270_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$サイガス$$
「There is a loophole.
　We need only claim that the colony's residents
　were Neo Zeon soldiers.」

stage0270_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$大統領$$
「Do you think such a thing can be permitted?」

stage0270_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$サイガス$$
「But this will keep the colonies in line.
　It achieves the greatest effect with minimal sacrifice.」

stage0270_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$大統領$$
「...Was this operation proposed by someone in Chrono?」

stage0270_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$大統領$$
「If I refuse to sign this operation,
　I will be assassinated like past leaders,
　and someone more pliable will take my place...」

stage0270_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$大統領$$
「Yes...
　Just as it was with Ricardo Marcenas,
　one of the founders of the $$宇宙世紀$$.」

stage0270_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$サイガス$$
「I cannot fathom what grounds you have for saying that,
　but I see you understand
　the position you are in.」

stage0270_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Please understand, Mr. $$大統領$$.
　We do not wish to kill Spacenoids
　indiscriminately.」

stage0270_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$大統領$$
「...Is this truly the right thing to do...?」

stage0270_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Thank you for your signature of approval.
　I will have the fleet begin preparations at once.」

stage0270_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$大統領$$
「...I may have done something
　that can never be undone...」

stage0270_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$クラウス$$
「No. Had you refused their demand,
　events would have unfolded exactly as you said
　and invited further military excesses.」

stage0270_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$シーリン$$
「Besides, not all of the Federation Forces
　have fallen to the Earth supremacists, to Chrono.」

stage0270_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$クラウス$$
「$c...
　Let us place our hopes in them.」

stage0270_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$大統領$$
「But we cannot leave them to fight alone.
　...$$シーリン$$, $$クラウス$$, have the members assemble
　in Dakar one week from now.」

stage0270_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$大統領$$
「The $$エタニティ・フラット$$...
　There, we will decide whether to reveal it publicly.」

stage0270_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, we're off to remote $$メリダ島$$...
　At least I'd like to pretend it's a vacation.」

stage0270_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, the situation doesn't exactly
　leave us that kind of leeway...」

stage0270_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But business is the one thing for me!
　Let's give it our all today... business, business!」

stage0270_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, I'll be staying in Japan too,
　so it looks like I can relax a little.」

stage0270_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, the situation doesn't exactly
　leave us that kind of leeway...」

stage0270_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But business is the one thing for me!
　Let's give it our all today... business, business!」
